newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended lower before the end of the Swiss Federal Treasury's bond auction Thursday.

Auction subscriptions close early at 0900 GMT ahead of a long Easter weekend. Swiss markets will be closed Friday and Monday. Tender results including allocation and yield are expected at about 1000 GMT.

Traders at some Swiss banks did not expect strong demand at the auction, comprising a 4-1/4 percent 2014 tranche and a 4-1/2 percent 2000 tranche. Negative comments focused on the 2014 tranche. "There is no need for duration lengthening and the bond is not extremely cheap," said one trader.
"It is difficult to price, because we don't have a reliable swap rate," the dealer added.
"I would expect the allocation for the 2014 will be very slight, maybe maximum 500 million Swiss francs including the 300 million the government has reserved for itself," a second trader said.
The 2000 tranche may garner some demand, however, with some traders seeing potential for price gains in the short end.
EuroSwiss three-month futures traded on LIFFE were slightly firmer on the day.
March Conf futures CONFH7 down 13 at 118.40.
March Comi medium-term bond COMIH7 down five at 111.20
Mar Euro Swiss francs FESH7 up one 98.17.
